name: smart-study
description: Smart Study - monorepo com backend (Express/MongoDB) e frontend (Vite/React)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
